newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS SQUANDER CHANCES BUT BEAT RAYO 2-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS SQUANDER CHANCES BUT BEAT RAYO 2-0.

text.p: Real Betis beat Rayo Vallecano 2-0 in the first leg of the Spanish Cup quarter-final on Wednesday but will feel they missed golden opportunities to virtually guarantee a place in the semifinals.
Betis took control from the start and went ahead in the 13th minute through Juan Sabas, who celebrated his goal by pulling up his shirt to expose a T-shirt bearing a picture of his newly-born son.

But Alexis Trujillo missed a penalty shortly afterwards and despite their complete dominance the Seville side failed to increase their lead until striker Alfonso Perez pounced on a defensive error 10 minutes from time.
Atletico Madrid were playing Barcelona later on Wednesday in another quarter-final first leg tie.
On Thursday Las Palmas are due to face Espanyol while Celta play Racing Santander.
